Thanks for signing up for Redwood and starting the trial — welcome! I pulled your account and it looks like you were exploring the embeddings and streaming response examples. Would love to show a compact 20-minute demo tailored to your use case (search relevance + cost controls).

If that works, here are 3 short slots I can do:
- Tue 11/30, 10:00–10:20 PT
- Tue 11/30, 14:30–14:50 PT
- Wed 12/01, 09:00–09:20 PT

Or book directly: https://calendly.com/redwood/20min-compact-demo

- 10 min live demo: embeddings + routing example
- 5 min next steps & pilot timeline

Attachments: compact-demo-agenda.pdf

If you prefer, I can loop in our AE Lauren (cc'd) to do a short technical dive. Any preferred slot?

3) If you'd prefer, we can send a short recording + a tailored cost comparison for your sample dataset.

Available reschedule slots:
- Thu 12/02, 10:15–10:35 PT

Thanks — happy to be flexible.
